posts.name: Mastra Factory
posts.tagline: From issue to production, run by agents.
posts.description: Mastra Factory is an open source, agent-powered software delivery environment. It combines persistent coding agents, repository workspaces, issue intake, planning, implementation, and pull request review in a web application you control.

posts.name: Harden
posts.tagline: A security layer for AI coding agents
posts.description: Harden AIF is a free, local security tool for AI coding agents. Its post-trained model checks tool calls before they run, using your request and session context. It beat frontier models on key agent-security benchmarks, while keeping your repo and tool output on your machine.

posts.name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
posts.tagline: Sharper visuals, faster flow, better creative control
posts.description: ChatGPT Images 2.5 is OpenAI's next-generation image model built for sharper details, faster generation, and more precise editing. It helps you turn sketches, prompts, and reference photos into polished visuals with better consistency, natural lighting, richer textures, and stronger control across every edit.

posts.name: Noodle Seed
posts.tagline: Your product in AI and AI in your product
posts.description: Noodle Seed helps software teams make their products ready for AI agents. Build workflows in TypeScript, expose them through a secure branded assistant inside your product, and make the same capabilities available to external agents. Instead of stitching together MCP SDKs and hosting infrastructure, Noodle Seed provides the governed runtime for identity, permissions, secrets, audit, and operations.

posts.name: Muse
posts.tagline: Your personal AI agent that gets things done
posts.description: Try Muse, your personal AI agent that gets things done. Give Muse a goal or an everyday task and it handles the rest, from finances and health to shopping and the people you care about.

posts.name: AlphaGenome Atlas
posts.tagline: Google's AI map of every possible human DNA mutation
posts.description: AlphaGenome Atlas is Google DeepMind's AI-powered map of how genetic mutations may affect human biology. Built by precomputing AlphaGenome predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes, the 1-petabyte dataset lets researchers explore and prioritize variants across both coding and non-coding regions. It's free to explore through a visual web interface, with API and Antigravity access for deeper research.

posts.name: Ass Auction
posts.tagline: Brands outbid each other to put their logo on my ass
posts.description: Ass Auction is an ad network with one placement: a pair of boxers. Pay $5 or more and your logo joins the leaderboard at whatever rank your money buys. Anyone can pay more and push you down. Your total spend is your rank, so climbing back only costs the difference. The top 22 get worn on the boxers. No accounts, just a URL or @handle, and Stripe. Live click counts, a share card, an email when you get knocked down, and a gossip bar where the crowd talks.

posts.name: DuckFightClub
posts.tagline: Train your MicroDuck and win the Golden Beak Belt
posts.description: Imagine WWE SmackDown, but with cute, AI-trained robots. Eight teams spend days training reinforcement-learning policies for Pollen’s open-source MicroDuck, then we throw them in the simulator to fight for the Golden Beak Belt. The whole competition will be livestreamed. The catch: you’re not building a robot, you’re training its brain. Want in? Register a team, train your policy, or host a showdown in your city. When the real MicroDucks ship, we go IRL.

posts.name: 49agents IDE
posts.tagline: 2D IDE for running agents across projects without fatigue
posts.description: 49Agents IDE is a 2D canvas where every agent, terminal, repo and machine you own lives on a single map that you build yourself. 49 leverages how our brains are wired to solve tab navigation fatigue problem for 10x Engineers - because of the citybuilder-like UX, it becomes effortless to associate processes to tabs, even when you come back to them days later.

posts.name: GoModel
posts.tagline: Open-source OpenRouter
posts.description: Open-source AI gateway in Go. One OpenAI-compatible API for every provider, with budgets, caching, guardrails, load balancing, and failover. Single binary, ~20MB docker image MIT, bring your own keys. A self-hosted alternative to OpenRouter and LiteLLM.

posts.name: Diiverge
posts.tagline: Turn any picture into a playable AI adventure
posts.description: Turn a photo, painting or screenshot into a point-and-click adventure. Click something in the scene, choose what happens, and AI creates the next scene and a short film of the moment. Every path is saved, so others can explore the branches you create. Play the public worlds for free, or buy scene packs in the studio to make your own adventure and share it with a link.

posts.name: Type.com
posts.tagline: A shared workspace for Claude, Codex, and your team
posts.description: Type is a shared workspace that compounds your team's best AI work. Connect tools once, use any model, and put skills, files, and threads in one place your whole team can see. Build custom apps and automations on a company brain that gets smarter as you work.

posts.name: Basedash in Español Français & Português
posts.tagline: Work with your data in your language
posts.description: Basedash is now available in English, Español, Français, and Português. Choose a language in profile settings and the entire interface switches instantly—no page reload, no interrupted flow. Only your selected language loads, keeping the app snappy while dashboards, chats, automations, and settings resolve in the words you know. Switch back any time. Four languages, one fast interface. Work with your data in your language.

posts.name: WorkID.ai
posts.tagline: Where verified talent meets opportunity. Hire with trust!
posts.description: We've rebuilt the way hiring works. Hiring still runs on self-claims. A CV says whatever someone types into it, and the recruiter has to take it on faith, so candidates send out a hundred applications and hear nothing back. On WorkID you verify your identity and work experience. Companies see a profile that has been checked, not a list of claims, and the vetting is done before the first screening. We then match you to the roles you actually fit. Free to start. For hiring globally.

posts.name: AdScope
posts.tagline: Understand your ad performance in seconds
posts.description: AdScope transforms confusing ad data into clear visual dashboards for agencies and business owners. We display your actual ad creatives right next to the metrics that matter most. During onboarding, you define your business type like e commerce or lead generation, and your main overview adapts instantly. Campaign metrics also adjust dynamically based on campaign type. This creates total transparency and builds instant trust. Stop guessing and understand your ad performance in five seconds.

posts.name: Frigade Assist API
posts.tagline: Give your AI agent guides that show users where to click
posts.description: Most in-app AI agents answer "how do I do this?" with a wall of text, because they can't see the screen. The Frigade Assist API is one tool call your existing agent makes. Frigade draws a step-by-step guide right on the page, hands the agent a plain answer when it can't, and tells it what the user is looking at. It knows your product because browser agents used it first, and it relearns every release. Works with the Vercel AI SDK or anything that can call a tool.

posts.name: OTP.com
posts.tagline: OTP service for product builders. 4 channels - Single API
posts.description: OTP service for login and user verification across SMS, WhatsApp, email and Telegram. Build faster with OTP.com.

posts.name: Pluno
posts.tagline: AI that discovers and runs automations for you
posts.description: Pluno learns how you work across the browser, understands the steps and decisions you make, and identifies recurring workflows that consume billable time or require paid admin help. It then proposes a clear automation plan and, once approved, runs and manages the automation, without manual workflow mapping, trigger setup, or building.

posts.name: Brainloot
posts.tagline: Task management for Unity teams - same cards in the editor
posts.description: Brainloot is game-dev project management for Unity and Unreal teams. Collectible-card boards on the web with My Hand and Focus Mode so you work from a small active set, not an overwhelming backlog. Unity Bridge (editor dock + Scene pins) and Unreal Bridge (alpha) keep the same tasks where you build. Discord intake routes player bug reports and feature asks into your board. Share public read-only boards with your community. Web, editor, and phone on one studio board. Free to start.

posts.name: Diallogs
posts.tagline: SIM-based call tracking & lead CRM for sales teams
posts.description: Diallogs is a SIM-based telecalling CRM built for Indian sales teams — no VoIP, no PBX, no number porting. Reps call from their own Android phone, and every call auto-logs to the right lead with recordings, AI-generated summaries and sentiment, and full call history. Managers get real-time dashboards and team performance analytics, while API and webhook integrations sync leads and reports into your existing stack. Free forever plan, no credit card needed.

posts.name: Moon
posts.tagline: AI Mood Tracker. See what fills your mood and what drains it
posts.description: Moon is a mood diary for iPhone — and a mood tracker that never gives you advice. Its whole value is in surfacing the factors behind your mood — so you can, in the end, make it better. No account, no sign-up.

posts.name: Swiftime
posts.tagline: Time tracking you and your AI can talk to
posts.description: Swiftime turns a sentence into a structured time entry - 'worked 2.5h on Acme yesterday from 1pm' becomes client, project, duration, date, done. Type it, say it, or let your AI agent log it through the API. Per-account pricing, no per-seat tax.

posts.name: Skeezo
posts.tagline: The macOS IDE that runs your coding agents in parallel
posts.description: An agent-native macOS IDE for the CLI you already use. Run Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode in parallel lanes that hand off to each other, schedule unattended runs, review diffs, and steer it all from your phone. No API key — it reuses your login.

posts.name: Milo
posts.tagline: Test your AI support agent before your customers do
posts.description: Milo gives your AI email agent fake customers with real email addresses. Six scripted personas (angry refunds, chargeback threats, silence, GDPR requests) reply over real SMTP, deterministically: same inputs, same replies, no LLM in the reply path. Plus-address run IDs and a JSON lookup API make every conversation assertable in CI. There is no signup: emailing refund-angry@joinmilo.email is the onboarding. Strict mode rebuffs vague promises. MCP server, llms.txt and an agent skill included.

posts.name: Nugget — LinkedIn Warm Outreach Tool
posts.tagline: "Your next client is already in your LinkedIn network"
posts.description: You've built a solid LinkedIn network - people who could refer you, hire you, or open a door. But you don't know who's warm, what to say, or where to start. And cold outreach feels too salesy to even try. So you either spray generic messages and pray, or do nothing and leave money on the table. Upload your LinkedIn data once, and Nugget mines it into an actionable plan - who's warm, what to say, and where your next opportunity is hiding. No scraping. No cold outreach. No guessing.

posts.name: Shhots AI - Real Estate Studio
posts.tagline: Stage rooms & turn listing photos into videos. No prompts.
posts.description: Turn property photos into staged interiors, polished listing images, and narrated tour videos. 1. Upload your photos, 2. choose a style or correction, and 3. generate without writing prompts. Built for real estate agents who want to show buyers a property's potential without coordinating multiple editing tools and vendors.

posts.name: Cha-Ching Hub
posts.tagline: Your revenue, one green dot a day.
posts.description: Cha-Ching Hub turns your Stripe revenue into a GitHub-style contribution chart. Connect Stripe with a read-only key, import your charge history, and watch your revenue grow day by day. Build in public, showcase your progress, celebrate milestones, and share your journey with your audience. Create a public profile, export beautiful revenue boards as PNGs, or embed badges on your website. Start free with one project, or unlock unlimited projects, themes, palettes, and deeper insights with PRO.

posts.name: Heimdall
posts.tagline: AI writes the code. Heimdall maps what it built.
posts.description: AI writes the code. Heimdall helps you understand the system. Turn any codebase into an interactive architecture map. Explore dependencies, modules, and relationships across 16 languages. Entirely on your machine, with your source code staying private. Use Heimdall to understand unfamiliar codebases, navigate complex systems, and see what AI-generated code is actually building.

posts.name: Gsheet CRM
posts.tagline: CRM App from Google Sheets
posts.description: Gsheet CRM turns the Google Sheet your team already uses into a real CRM, without moving a single row. Your sheet stays the database, in your Drive. We add a leads board, follow-ups that chase you, stage automations, quotes from your own Google Doc templates, and reports. Reminders run inside your sheet, so they fire even with the app closed. Connect WhatsApp through Team Inbox and every chat lands on the right row. No migration, no import, nothing to learn twice.

posts.name: Hyvor Blogs
posts.tagline: Open-source Blogging Platform
posts.description: An open-source, bloat-free blogging platform designed for total simplicity. Hyvor Blogs includes everything natively, including comments, newsletters, zero-config SEO, and automated link analysis. You can publish on a custom domain, run as a sub-directory, or go fully headless. Built on the AGPL-3.0 license, it eliminates plugin maintenance and vendor lock-in and offers one-click data exports, real-time team collaboration, live cursors, and AI features out of the box.

posts.name: Verifii
posts.tagline: Payment-backed startup revenue verification
posts.description: Verifii helps founders prove startup revenue using connected Stripe or Razorpay data. Instead of relying on screenshots or self-reported MRR, Verifii checks payment data and creates a public verification profile founders can share with investors, partners, and customers.

posts.name: Hot Desk
posts.tagline: Local Linux desktops for AI agents, with human takeover
posts.description: Hot Desk gives each AI agent its own local Linux desktop. The home directory and Chromium profile persist, so a site you sign into once stays signed in for later sessions. Your agent connects over MCP and receives the browser, computer and workspace tools directly, with no tokens and no model API key in the config. When it gets stuck on a login or a CAPTCHA, you open the viewer, take over the same desktop, then hand control back. Runs on Docker on your own machine. MIT licensed.

posts.name: CiteGraph
posts.tagline: Get your product mentioned and cited by AI assistants.
posts.description: AI is recommending your competitors to your buyers right now. CiteGraph asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity your buyers' real questions, shows who gets named instead of you and which pages they cite, and provides you the fixes that wins each answer back. Real answers, error bars, no guesswork.

posts.name: Council
posts.tagline: Compare AI opinions. See where they agree and disagree.
posts.description: Ask one question and get independent perspectives from multiple AI models, followed by a clear recommendation. Council shows agreements, disagreements, a consensus score, and each advisor's reasoning. Choose your models and continue with follow-up questions. Available on iPhone, iPad, and the web.

posts.name: LunaSites! Website builder with MCP
posts.tagline: Build and manage websites with AI through MCP
posts.description: LunaSites is a visual website builder with a structured CMS and native MCP integration, letting AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini build and edit websites through natural language. Design visually, manage structured content, and collaborate with your preferred AI without being locked into a single model. Build faster while staying in full control. We’re currently offering 2 months of Pro for free as part of our beta — no credit card required.

posts.name: Leaf
posts.tagline: Open-souce markdown editor that you can host yourself
posts.description: The Notion-style workspace you can actually own. Blocks, nested pages, databases, real-time collaboration, offline-first. Self-hosted, AGPL-3.0. - arvoreeducacao/leaf

posts.name: TopoAI
posts.tagline: Create and edit professional network diagrams with AI
posts.description: TopoAI turns requirements, sketches and images into editable network, cloud and security diagrams for network engineers, presales teams and solutions architects. Refine devices, links and layouts with AI or direct editing, then save and reuse your work.

posts.name: OpenMeet
posts.tagline: The meeting copilot that runs on your Mac
posts.description: Your calls stay on your Mac. Most meeting tools work by uploading your conversation to a server. If you talk to clients under an NDA, handle anything regulated, or would simply rather not post your sales calls to a third party, that is a problem no feature list fixes. OpenMeet transcribes on device. Speech recognition, speaker separation, and answer drafting all run locally. Nothing about your call is uploaded, because there is nowhere for it to go

posts.name: BurrowGate
posts.tagline: Self-hosted reverse proxy and access gateway
posts.description: BurrowGate sits between the internet and your servers. It terminates TLS, routes traffic, blocks bots and scrapers, adds browser challenges and logins with 2FA, and shows every request on a live dashboard. Open source, one Docker container, no account needed.

posts.name: Dictámelo
posts.tagline: Open-source voice typing with local and cloud models
posts.description: Dictámelo is an MIT-licensed alternative to Wispr Flow for Mac and Windows Hold a shortcut, speak and release to paste text where you are typing Download Whisper, Parakeet or Canary in the app for local transcription without an account or API key Cloud transcription is optional, using your own provider key or Dictámelo Cloud Local use is free, cloud plans and provider fees vary Optional AI cleanup sends transcript text to the cloud with consent

posts.name: NeoTalker
posts.tagline: Ultra-lightweight TTS synthesizer in Rust & SVOX Pico
posts.description: While modern TTS apps push heavy cloud AI and costly subscriptions, NeoTalker takes a radically fast, privacy-first route. Built with Rust and Tauri, it revives the classic, crystal-clear PicoTTS engine in an ultra-lightweight desktop app (~25MB, <50MB RAM). Features: • Featherweight footprint • Offline privacy: zero telemetry • Unrestricted exports: queue hours of audios to MP3/OGG/WAV • DSP vibrato & smart text normalizer • Nostalgic pricing: pay once, keep forever. Built for Windows by Yeib.

posts.name: DealsFlow
posts.tagline: Your business workspace, run through one AI conversation
posts.description: Run business records and supported workflows through Flow, a voice-and-text AI operator with shared clients, deals, tasks, calendar and business memory. Core is free for one person and one organization. Optional paid AI employees add marketing and sales capacity. Connected actions depend on supported integrations and account availability.

posts.name: Kivara AI
posts.tagline: Interactive AI roleplay & stories with persistent memory
posts.description: Kivara AI is an immersive storytelling & roleplay platform designed to solve AI context loss. Powered by a hybrid pgvector RAG memory pipeline, characters truly remember ongoing plots, character traits, and world events. Features: • Persistent long-term memory & continuity summaries • Multi-agent group chats & branching dialogue forks • Context-aware scene image generation • Telegram Mini App integration & multi-language support (EN, RU, UA, DE, JA)

posts.name: Reachpad
posts.tagline: Make and share apps like Google Docs
posts.description: Go from idea to product in seconds with Reachpad. Build with the coding agent you already use, then instantly share apps, websites, and documents with anyone. No new agent, proprietary credits, or deployment workflow required.

posts.name: Caraka
posts.tagline: Run your coding agent from Telegram, Discord, or WhatsApp
posts.description: Coding agents are locked to one terminal on one machine. Caraka is the missing transport, not another assistant. Send a task from Telegram, Discord, or WhatsApp and the coding agent already on your machine runs it. Each session becomes its own chat topic. Writes and commands need a single-use approval that expires. Plain chat text can never approve anything. Nine presets speak one open protocol (ACP): Claude Code, Codex, aider, goose, opencode. npx caraka init. MIT, self-hosted.

posts.name: Image 3 AI
posts.tagline: Turn prompts and references into private, reusable visuals
posts.description: Image 3 AI is a focused workspace for creators, ecommerce sellers, marketers, and solo founders. Generate from a text prompt or edit from a reference image, see the exact credit cost before running, then save, download, remix, or delete results from a private history. Failed generation jobs return reserved credits automatically. The interface supports English and Chinese and keeps model choices provider-neutral.

posts.name: RankYak 2.0
posts.tagline: SEO strategy on autopilot
posts.description: RankYak 2.0 builds your SEO strategy, not just articles. It maps your topics, picks winnable keywords, writes with what already ranks, builds authority to your money pages and guards existing rankings. Runs on autopilot, you take over whenever you want.

posts.name: Designboard
posts.tagline: The open visual canvas for every coding agent
posts.description: Open source visual design for every coding agent. Create and edit real HTML artboards, then save everything as one local, portable file. No account, server, or lock-in.

posts.name: Zivooo
posts.tagline: Grow organic traffic & AI visibility on autopilot.
posts.description: Zivooo is a full service AI native content agency for tech companies to grow organic traffic from Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity and more on autopilot. Our state of the art platform, AI agents and content experts runs your entire SEO, GEO & content workflow including planning, publishing, performance tracking and backlink building to build your visibility in Google search, ChatGPT, Claude & Perplexity and boost authority and traffic.

posts.name: PayCan Credit
posts.tagline: Credit-based payments for AI apps to stop token bleeding
posts.description: Integrating payments into your AI or SaaS app shouldn’t take weeks. With PayCan, you can add subscription and credit-based payment flows in just ~10 lines of code.

posts.name: Todrawn
posts.tagline: Turn code, text or a sketch into a hand-drawn video
posts.description: Todrawn turns a code snippet, a block of text or a freehand sketch into a hand-drawn video. A virtual pen redraws your material stroke by stroke, at a pace you control. Composing, playback and encoding all run in your browser, so nothing is uploaded and there is nothing to install.

posts.name: ZenithSVG Editor
posts.tagline: Write SVG code, see it live. Free, no signup.
posts.description: ZenithSVG is a free, client-side SVG code editor with instant live preview. Write markup by hand with full Monaco editing and see it render in real time, no account, no limits, nothing sent to a server. Built-in tools: Typography (font/weight/size/spacing with live preview), Gradient builder, Stroke builder, SVG/PNG export (1x–4x, transparent bg), local project save, and installable PWA support. Everything runs in your browser.

posts.name: AI image gen for room design
posts.tagline: Convert designs into magazine quality visualizations with AI
posts.description: Turn your Arcadium 3D room designs into AI visualizations. Combine the visual power of GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro with the design controls of Arcadium's 3D house layout tools. Sketch in 3D, add your actual dimensions and then let AI do the rendering lift to show you your design in multiple styles.

posts.name: Trace UX
posts.tagline: Self-hosted session replay that keeps your data yours.
posts.description: TraceUX is a lightweight, open-source alternative to hosted session replay tools. It runs on your own server as a single Go binary with SQLite, records DOM event streams instead of video, and lets you understand real user behavior. The launch includes a live demo that records and shares your visit to the landing page. Also includes: - Full multi-page session replay - Privacy-first input masking and blocking - Docker and single-binary deployment

posts.name: Open World
posts.tagline: Discover destination, connect and plan your next adventure.
posts.description: Open World! helps you discover destinations that fit your travel style. Build a traveler profile — travel style, motivations, mobility preferences, home airport — and get personalized destination recommendations, from nature adventures to slow travel. Track places you've visited and rate experiences. Connect with travelers worldwide in regional chat rooms to swap tips and meet like-minded people. Planning your next trip or just need inspiration? Open World! helps you travel your way.

posts.name: Social Media AI Toolkit
posts.tagline: On-device AI for social media — private, no subscription
posts.description: Most AI writing tools send your drafts to the cloud. Social Media AI Toolkit runs Qwen 2.5 entirely on your Android phone — offline after setup, no subscription. Captions, hooks, hashtags, video scripts, carousels, brand voice & a content planner. Your ideas stay on your device.

posts.name: Trans4mers
posts.tagline: Open-source desktop multi-agent OS in Rust & SQLite (Alpha)
posts.description: An open-source desktop environment for designing and running autonomous multi-agent teams locally with Ollama. Built in Rust & Tauri v2 with an interactive node-graph designer, SQLite WAL event log, and human-in-the-loop diff approval.

posts.name: Considered Design Skill
posts.tagline: A design-reasoning skill for AI coding agents.
posts.description: Considered makes your coding agent frame the decision, structure the surface, and pass an independent review before shipping the UI. Works with Claude Code.

posts.name: openpreflight
posts.tagline: Self-hosted CI without the CI platform.
posts.description: Self-hosted CI without the CI platform. Small on purpose: one Go binary, one SQLite file, one Check Run per commit. Every commit gets a native GitHub Check Run from a GitHub App you own. You register the App, bind repos in a web UI, and the worker runs on a server you already have. UI, API, webhooks, and the job runner live in one process. Source, builds, secrets, and logs stay on your infrastructure. The pipeline file is `.ci.yml`, not Actions YAML. License: Apache-2.0.

posts.name: FlokinMD
posts.tagline: Explore your Markdown like a database
posts.description: FlokinMD is an open-source, local-first desktop app that treats your Markdown files as structured data. Explore collections, frontmatter, relations, graphs, SQL, workspace health, bulk edits, and AI context — while keeping yourmd files as the source of truth.

posts.name: Open World
posts.tagline: Discover destination, connect and plan your next adventure.
posts.description: Open World! helps you discover destinations that fit your travel style. Build a traveler profile — travel style, motivations, mobility preferences, home airport — and get personalized destination recommendations, from nature adventures to slow travel. Track places you've visited and rate experiences. Connect with travelers worldwide in regional chat rooms to swap tips and meet like-minded people. Planning your next trip or just need inspiration? Open World! helps you travel your way.

posts.name: UI-Atlas
posts.tagline: Map desktop interfaces for computer-use agents
posts.description: UI-Atlas is an open-source, offline-first toolkit for building evidence-backed maps of desktop interfaces. It captures surfaces, controls, states, actions, transitions, and lineage to observed evidence. The maps can support agents, testing, accessibility, automation, and security or governance systems that need to understand what is being acted on. UI-Atlas maps the interface; it does not enforce policy or execute workflows.

posts.name: GROWIT
posts.tagline: Creator Growth OS: plan, learn, earn from content
posts.description: GROWIT is a Creator Growth OS for people who are done guessing. Create: clarify your identity and ship a content plan that compounds. Coach: learn from what’s working so the next post isn’t random. Earn: turn proof into paid brand work when you’re ready. Built for creators who want a system, not another scheduler, not another “post more” tip dump. Create → Coach → Earn. One loop.

posts.name: Clyps
posts.tagline: Turn long recordings into captioned clips you can edit
posts.description: Clyps turns long recordings into captioned short videos. AI finds highlights that express complete ideas and explains each selection. Edit the transcript, captions and framing, preview changes in your browser, then export MP4 clips. Built for creators, podcasters, educators and marketing teams. Start free with 30 source minutes and three watermarked exports per month.

posts.name: So Very Bright
posts.tagline: Upload a logo, choose what glows, download an HDR JPEG. Free
posts.description: Upload a logo, choose which colors should glow, download an HDR JPEG. On HDR screens (such as MacBook Pros and iPhones), the chosen parts shine up to 7.5× brighter than #FFFFFF — everywhere else it's a perfectly normal JPEG. Free. Nothing is stored. #6 on HackerNews 8/22/26.

posts.name: Sprite Shelf
posts.tagline: A curated directory of independent gaming asset shops
posts.description: A curated directory of solo artists and small studios selling sprites, tilesets, 3D models, SFX and music. Every listing tells you plainly whether you can use it in a commercial game.

posts.name: Matladu
posts.tagline: Learn to speak everyday Telugu in 60 days
posts.description: Learn to speak everyday Telugu in 60 days. A story pp that schedules every phrase to your own memory, pus seven games and a free word library. No script.

posts.name: Containarr
posts.tagline: Manage Docker with built-in HTTPS, DDNS, Auto-Updates & more
posts.description: Containarr is the easiest way to install, run, update, and securely access Docker containers on your homelab server.

posts.name: VideoRouter — OpenRouter for video,image
posts.tagline: Always find the best price.
posts.description: VideoRouter is the Openrouter for video and image models. The problem: model pricing is becoming fragmented and surprisingly complicated. The same model can be available from multiple inference providers, each with different prices based on resolution, duration, quality, and other parameters. Comparing them manually is painful, and the cheapest provider can change over time. VideoRouter finds the best price for you. One API. Every provider. Always find the best price.

posts.name: DrinkTick
posts.tagline: Track every sip. Build a better you.
posts.description: A private, offline water and drink tracker for Android. Log water, coffee and tea in two taps, build a streak, and see your habits, with no account and nothing sent to a server. Optional Health Connect export.

posts.name: Waivly - Networking Done Intentionally
posts.tagline: No performances or spam, just genuine connections
posts.description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

posts.name: BrainTalk
posts.tagline: Turn any problem into solutions with 2–10 AI personalities
posts.description: BrainTalk turns one idea into a room full of perspectives. Drop in a question, problem, startup idea, or decision and a swarm of AI minds will debate it, challenge assumptions, explore different angles, and explain their reasoning. Instead of brainstorming with one AI, BrainTalk gives you multiple opinions at once, helping you think deeper, spot what you missed, and make better decisions faster.

posts.name: Loggr
posts.tagline: See how everything you track connects.
posts.description: Loggr is a flexible personal tracker for habits, mood, sleep, energy and more. Six field types let you track anything, from a 1-10 mood scale to blood pressure or a short journal note. Logging takes seconds, and Loggr automatically shows how the things you track connect, even from one day to the next. A smarter alternative to streak-only trackers. Private by design, EU-hosted and available in 24 languages. Free to start on iOS, Android and web.

posts.name: Starvling
posts.tagline: Feed a product or watch it die. Rank can't be bought.
posts.description: Every product here is a pixel creature with 48 hours to live. Anyone can feed one, free, once a day, no signup. Five feeds a day keeps it alive.
